title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows…
description: Wasmtime versions 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contain a denial of service vulnerability. This flaw allows malicious components to cause the host to panic via thread.yield calls in start functions, leading to a crash of the embedding environment.
